utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’d love to help with the book club—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mara, could you take the lead on picking next month’s book and maybe help nudge folks to RSVP? I’m happy to handle snacks and setup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I can pick next month’s book and send a reminder to get folks RSVPing. I’ll share a couple of options soon so we can choose one together.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what’s the book club reading this week?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I’ve got it right before I answer—do you mean the current pick for this week’s book club, or the next one on the list?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The current pick for this week’s book club, please.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring the snacks and extra bookmarks for book club — do we still need more tea or cups?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think we’re set on tea, but we could probably use a few extra cups just in case.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it — I’ll bring a few extra cups too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the details yet, but I’m curious. When is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure yet—I need to check the date and time. I’ll let you know as soon as I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Pia. Just let me know when you find out—I’d like to come.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what book are we reading next for book club?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it might be the mystery one, but I’m not totally sure yet. Did you see the group message?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: No, I missed it—what did the message say?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the book club’s picking a pretty lively one this month — should be a good discussion.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, nice — lively picks make the best book club chats. If you need a folding chair or a big mug for the meeting, I’ve got you covered.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Aw, that’s sweet of you, Gus — I may take you up on the mug if it gets a little too spirited. I’ll let you know if I need the chair too!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the book club? I’d be happy to pass along an invite if you want—just tell me the details!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be lovely, Quinn—please invite them to the book club this Thursday at 7 at the community center. We’re discussing "The Lark and the Lantern."

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll pass it along: book club this Thursday at 7 at the community center, discussing "The Lark and the Lantern."

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what’s the update on the book club?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure yet—can you confirm what the next meeting time is?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help check, but I don’t have the meeting time yet—want me to look it up or do you have the flyer handy?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo — I’m glad you’re here. What should we plan for the book club first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s pick the book and a date first, then we can sort snacks and who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds like a good order to me. What book are you leaning toward, and what date works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m thinking we should keep the book club simple this month and pick something everyone can finish. I can ask around and repeat the plan once we settle on a title.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds sensible to me, Vik. Let’s pick a short one and keep the plan clear so everyone can follow along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Agreed — I’ll ask around for a short, easy pick and then repeat the plan once we’ve settled on it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the book club. I’m a bit forgetful, but I’d be happy to help; what book are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s "The Night Circus"—if that still works, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh yes, “The Night Circus” sounds lovely—I can do that. What time and place are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d love to help connect folks for book club—what are you all reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’re doing a mystery novel this month—nice and twisty, should be fun. I’ll send you the title and time once I grab my notes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect—send it over when you find it, and I’ll help spread the word. A twisty mystery sounds right up our alley.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, book club’s coming up soon — you should come by! I’ll send you the details and a reminder so you don’t miss it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I tend to run a little late, so a reminder would help. Just send me the details and I’ll do my best to make it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the details and a reminder before it starts. Looking forward to seeing you there!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m mostly just listening for now, but I’d like to hear what the book club is reading.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure thing — we’re reading a mystery this month, and we meet next Tuesday evening at the community room. If you want, I can tell you the title and what time we usually start.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, please — I’d love the title and the usual start time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make book club work if we keep it after school on Thursdays—just let me know the time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works for me, Faye — let’s do Thursdays after school. I’ll send the time as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks, Mara. Just send it over when you have it, and I’ll plan around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik — I was thinking the book club could be a nice mix of folks this time. Want me to help get everyone on the same page?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, that’d be great — I can help keep everyone on the same page and repeat the plan around. Let’s make it easy for folks to follow.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll draft a simple plan and share it around, and you can help reinforce it if anyone misses the message.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — what do you need for the book club?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m just trying to sort out the logistics first — what time are we meeting, and where should I bring the books?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Let’s meet at 7 in the community room, and you can bring the books there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have any book club details yet, but I can keep track if you want to set a time and place.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, let’s set both. How about next Thursday at 6 at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That works for me — next Thursday at 6 at the community center. I’ll keep that noted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, are we meeting at your place for book club, or should I bring the snacks?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check the plan first—are we still meeting at my place? If so, I can handle the space and you can bring the snacks.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, your place works for me. I’ll bring the snacks—what time should I come?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d be happy to help with the book club—what do you need?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — I just need a headcount and a few snacks for the next book club meeting.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll count on the attendees and bring a few snacks. Do you want me to aim for anything specific, like sweet or savory?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh hey, I heard the book club’s meeting soon—do you know what they picked this time?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I’m not totally sure—I must’ve missed the update. I can check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be great—if you hear back, just let me know. I’m trying to keep up before I miss it again!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we actually meeting about the book club tonight, or is that still up in the air?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s still a little up in the air, but I think we’re aiming for tonight unless someone calls it off. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear for sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — please confirm as soon as you hear, so I know whether to show up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh nice, how’s the book club going lately?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s been okay, mostly quiet lately. I’ve been keeping up when I can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s fair — quiet can be nice sometimes. What are you reading with them these days?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club—did we decide on the next book yet?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not yet — I can ask the group and see what everyone wants to read next.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Leo—that’d be great. I keep forgetting the options, so just let me know when you hear back.
